intro: Self-guided walks full of stories, riddles and hidden places. Part city guide, part treasure hunt, all in your mobile browser.

steps.chooseText: Pick a route and start it on your phone. No app to download.
steps.followText: Walk from stop to stop. Each location reveals its story when you arrive.
steps.solveText: Crack riddles and answer questions to unlock the next hidden place.

featured.title: Start with {title}
featured.text: Our first route, and a great place to begin. Explore the other walks, and keep an eye out for new routes on the way.
